Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the DPA and checklist. A few initial comments from our side after a quick review:

- Retention: we can't accept a "indefinite" or open-ended data retention period. Can you propose a maximum retention window for customer data (12–24 months typical for our environment)?
- Liability: Acme will need a data liability cap in line with our commercial terms (we'll share redline examples).
- HIPAA: one of our lines of business handles PHI — we'll need confirmation Redwood will support a HIPAA-compliant flow (BAA language) and any relevant scoping.
- SOC2 / CAIQ: please provide the most recent SOC 2 Type II report (or redact PII sections) and a completed CAIQ or SIG-lite.

Also, who is the intended Acme signature authority for this engagement? Our procurement contact prefers DocuSign but will need the correct signer email.

I'll loop in our procurement lead if we proceed with the DocuSign path.

Best,
Ana Morales
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Security
Acme Corp

Jordan — quick guidance below. Attaching SOC2 and CAIQ summary for Acme's immediate review.

- Retention: propose: "Customer Personal Data will be retained for the shorter of (i) the period necessary to provide Services (not to exceed 24 months following termination) or (ii) as required by applicable law. Customer may request earlier deletion subject to Service constraints." This gives a clear 24‑month cap while allowing lawful holds.
- HIPAA / PHI: we can offer a BAA addendum for the Acme line-of-business that processes PHI. Suggest adding an explicit BAA reference and a schedule that scopes in the relevant products only.
- SCCs / transfers: recommend we accept standard EU SCCs and include a supplemental transfer addendum referencing our subprocessor controls. If Acme requests more (e.g., DTA with additional audits), escalate to Legal Ops.
- SOC2/CAIQ: attached files: SOC2-report-2028.pdf (redacted) and CAIQ-summary-answers.xlsx. These should satisfy the majority of the questionnaire; highlight any gaps for us to fill.

If you want me to propose the exact redline language, I can drop it into the DPA and send a consolidated version back to Ana.

-Neha Kapoor
Head of Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
